plan.note: UT floor-plan set, 1/32" = 1'-0". Tower (floors 4-8) measures 265-267 ft wide vs 265.8 ft in OSM.

frame.origin: sheet point (87 pt, 785 pt) on floors 4-8, about the lower-left corner of the tower's outer walls
frame.axes: x = right on the sheet, y = up on the sheet; sheet up is about 5 deg east of true north
frame.registration: floors 4-8 share one sheet placement; B-3 are shifted onto it by matching structural columns (residual ~0.01 ft, cross-checked by outline and loop closure)

datum.description: Level 1 = 0 ft model datum; not surveyed altitude

vertical.note: The official inventory confirms nine floors. The architect-provided transverse section shows unequal lower-level spacing, but has no labeled floor IDs, vertical datum, or elevation dimensions; its graphic scale has no units. No dimensioned level schedule was verified. Neither floor count nor photographs establish floor-to-floor dimensions, basement elevation, or wall heights.

sources.title: UT building inventory: Engineering Education and Research Center (0223)
sources.evidence: Lists nine floors and identifies restricted floor plans. No vertical dimensions are published on the inventory page.

sources.title: Ennead: Engineering Education and Research Center
sources.evidence: Primary architect project description and architectural imagery. No verified numerical floor elevations or floor-to-floor schedule were recovered from the reviewed material.

sources.title: Ennead architect-provided EERC transverse section, published by ArchDaily
sources.evidence: The original 2000 x 1500 image shows unequal lower-level spacing. The graphic scale has no units, and floor IDs, a vertical datum, and elevation dimensions are absent. This establishes a limitation of uniform spacing, not numerical level heights.

sources.title: UT EER drawing portal (restricted access)
sources.evidence: Official inventory link redirects to UT authentication. No additional drawing contents or elevations were verified through this portal.
